name: NordPass
description: NordPass is a password manager built on zero-knowledge architecture that stores, autofills, and monitors credentials for individuals, families, and businesses.
best_for: Individuals, families, and small-to-enterprise businesses wanting simple, zero-knowledge password management with compliance oversight.
features: Zero-knowledge, end-to-end encryption using the XChaCha20 algorithm
Data Breach Scanner with alerts when company domains or emails appear on the dark web
Sharing Hub for secure team credential sharing
Email masking to generate aliases and reduce phishing risk
Browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, and Edge

alternatives.name: Dashlane
alternatives.description: A password manager and credential security platform with phishing and breach detection.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting proactive credential risk detection

alternatives.description: An open-source password manager for individuals and organizations.
alternatives.best_for: Users and teams wanting an open-source, self-hostable option

alternatives.description: A password manager and secrets vault for individuals, families, and businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a polished password manager with strong admin controls
